TROLLfx RTA V0.5.5. The live RTA, analyzer supervision, microphone capture and saved-sweep engine are unchanged from V0.5.4. Native START and CANCEL touch buttons use existing momentary parameters. Eight radio selectors choose Latest/Previous 2–8 existing sessions; completed sweeps still save automatically. The result graph remains a parameter-bound 16,642-frame PNG filmstrip and has not been verified on Force firmware. Keep Force playback on Internal Audio. See FORCE-NATIVE-V055-README.md and FORCE-NATIVE-V055-VALIDATION.md.
